title: Two schools
instructions: Deniz eski okuluyla yeni okulunu karşılaştırıyor. Hangi bilginin hangi okula ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: This year, I started at a new school.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: My old school was small, with only two hundred students. My new school is big. It has a thousand students!

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: At my old school, I walked to school. Now I take the bus. It takes thirty minutes.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: My new school has a swimming pool, but my old school had a beautiful garden.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: The lessons are more difficult now, but the teachers are very kind.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: I miss my old friends, but I have two new friends, Elif and Can.

questions.prompt: How many students were at her old school?
questions.feedback: Eski okulunda sadece iki yüz öğrenci vardı; yenisinde bin.

questions.prompt: How does Deniz go to her new school?
questions.feedback: Yeni okula otobüsle gidiyor; eski okula yürüyordu.

questions.prompt: What does the new school have?
questions.feedback: Yeni okulun havuzu var; güzel bahçe eski okuldaydı.
questions.evidence: My new school has a swimming pool

questions.prompt: What does she say about the lessons now?
questions.evidence: The lessons are more difficult now
